about.title: About
about.description: An unofficial Android port of stark81’s VutronMusic / Vutron project, reusing original icons, themes and shared components. Built with Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, Capacitor and native Android adapters.
about.licenseSummary: The original MIT license is retained. Bundled components keep their own terms, including LGPL and GPL with the Classpath Exception. The documents below are available offline.
about.externalHint: These links connect to GitHub in your browser only when opened. Music-account cookies are not sent.
about.documentFailed: Could not read the local document. Go back and try again.

netease.deleteHint: Delete the NetEase playlist “{name}”? Playlist deletion cannot be undone. Cached audio and original files are kept.
netease.removeHint: Remove this song from your playlist “{name}”? Audio, cache and current playback are kept.
netease.name: Playlist name
netease.tagsHint: Up to 3 NetEase tags, separated by semicolons.
netease.refreshRequired: The last operation is unconfirmed or its refresh failed. Sync again before submitting another change.
netease.onlineRequired: Sign in to NetEase and leave local-only mode to use this action.
netease.unavailable: Playlist management is unavailable in this native build
netease.incomplete: Incomplete server data. The previous state has been kept; sync again.
netease.completed: Change saved and server data synced
netease.emptyOwn: No editable playlists. Create one from the online library or sidebar.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.subtitle: Settings and local playlist metadata · JSON
backup.description: Save appearance, lyric settings and offsets, track and playlist volumes, local playlist metadata and custom ordering. The playback queue is saved as a separate metadata playlist.
backup.restoreHint: Accounts, cookies, audio, cover caches, absolute paths and folder permissions are excluded. Import creates metadata playlists. Select the original folders or import the original bundles, then reopen a restored playlist to link its audio. Ambiguous files stay unlinked.
backup.confirm: Merge backup settings and create restored playlist metadata. Existing playlists, original audio and the current playback queue stay intact. Select the original folders or import original bundles to link missing audio.
backup.imported: Backup imported with {count} restored playlists. Relink any missing audio.
backup.missingHint: Audio is not included. Select the original folders or import original bundles, then reopen this playlist.

ordering.dragHint: Drag a handle to reorder. Press Back or Cancel to discard this drag.
ordering.clearFilter: Clear the search to drag. Searching never changes the saved order.
ordering.saveFailed: Could not save the order. Please retry.
ordering.requiresOnline: This song has online metadata only. Leave local mode and sign in to play it.
ordering.empty: No tracks. Select a music folder or import a playlist bundle.

imports.chooseHint: No root manifest.json was found. Local audio import is the default and uses no network. Optionally sign in and attempt online metadata matching. Failed or cancelled matching keeps local audio and never switches to streaming.
imports.unavailable: This version cannot continue the import
imports.matchSummary: Local audio imported; metadata matched for {matched}/{total} tracks
imports.matchingStopped: Metadata matching stopped; local audio was retained

management.cacheRetained: Keep playlist metadata, artwork and lyrics
management.cacheInUse: The current track still uses this cache. Switch tracks before deleting it. Playback will not be stopped automatically.
management.cacheRemoved: Cached audio deleted; playlist metadata, artwork and lyrics retained
management.removeTrackHint: Remove only the index or playlist entry, keeping original audio. Scanned tracks remain excluded until restored in directory management. If this track is playing, stop it before updating the queue.
management.deletePlaylistHint: Delete this playlist's app-owned copy and entries, keeping the original ZIP and external audio. If this playlist is playing, stop playback and clear the entire queue.
management.forgetFolderHint: Release folder access and remove its index and queue entries. Original phone files remain intact. An affected playing track will be stopped. Select the folder again to rescan.
management.restoreRemovedHint: Clear folder exclusions and rescan. This does not restore removed imported-playlist entries or deleted playlist copies.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Applies immediately and is saved on this device. Track names, playlist names, lyrics and app branding retain their original content.

login.localHint: Play local files and cached tracks without an account or network. You can sign in later in Settings.

library.noQueue: Choose a track in a playlist to populate the queue
library.title: Track title
library.reauthorize: Access expired · tap to grant access
library.reauthorizeHint: Folder access has expired. Choose the original music folder again.

home.updated: Home refreshed. Daily recommendations may remain unchanged.
home.cached: No new content was retrieved. Showing saved content.

updates.title: Check for updates
updates.defaultOff: Off by default. When enabled, checks at startup or resume at most once every 6 hours. Download and installation require confirmation.
updates.localPaused: Automatic checks are paused in local-only mode. Tapping Check for updates connects to GitHub without sending your music account.
updates.informationOnly: This build only displays public release information. It does not download or install packages from another release channel.
updates.androidRequired: Install the Android app to check for updates
updates.permission: Allow this app to install updates in Android settings, then return and tap Continue installation.
updates.unavailable: Unable to complete the update. Try again.
